name: radio-group
useFor: Use for one choice among two to five visible options (Tunnel TLS mode: Edge (default), Passthrough). Stack options 8px apart, each with its label 8px from the circle. For more options use Select; for an immediate view switch use Tabs or Toggle Group.
constraints: A filled dot for the chosen option
A single radio on its own
source: The Inkbox console's Radio theme (6px brand ring when checked); Figma 427:2715: Tunnel TLS mode radios in Create Agent Identity
title: Radio Group
description: 18px circles with a 1.5px strong edge; the chosen one takes a 6px brand purple ring around a white center.
